summary: The page layout is structured well, but contains inconsistent styling between OTP slot groups and a tree guide alignment collision in the file list.

issues.title: Inconsistent slot group styling
issues.description: The first and second OTP groups render with mismatched slot container styles and backgrounds.
issues.evidence: Slots 1-3 display as distinct white cards, whereas slots 4-6 render inside a single connected grey container.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent slot background and border tokens across both groups.

issues.title: Tree guideline icon collision
issues.description: Vertical tree guide line collides with the file icon.
issues.evidence: The left hierarchy guide line intersects the package.json file icon border.
issues.suggestion: Increase left padding on the row content to clear the guide line.
